messages.content: The airline just emailed that the Friday return I was looking at has moved to 5:40 p.m. That will not work with the museum handoff now confirmed for 6:30. What can replace it?

I checked the return options for Chicago to Atlanta. The latest nonstop on Friday departs O’Hare at 8:55 p.m., but reaching it after a 6:30 handoff would be tight unless you leave the museum by about 7:00. There is also a Saturday nonstop departing O’Hare at 10:15 a.m. and arriving in Atlanta at 1:12 p.m. The Saturday flight adds $46 to the itinerary.
The handoff may run until 7:15, so I do not want to gamble on Friday. Is there an earlier Saturday flight that does not add much more?

Yes. A Saturday nonstop leaves O’Hare at 8:05 a.m. and arrives in Atlanta at 11:02 a.m. It adds $61, which is $15 more than the 10:15 departure. Both are standard economy and allow advance seat selection.
Take the 8:05. Please confirm the full timing before you ticket it.

The unchanged outbound leaves Atlanta Tuesday, October 14 at 8:20 a.m. and reaches O’Hare at 9:35 a.m. The replacement return leaves O’Hare Saturday, October 18 at 8:05 a.m. and arrives in Atlanta at 11:02 a.m. The added fare is $61, and no separate change fee applies.
That works. Ticket it, and check whether I need to add Friday night at the Silversmith.

The Saturday 8:05 a.m. return is now ticketed. Your Silversmith reservation already runs through Saturday, October 18, with checkout that morning, so Friday night is included and no extension is needed.
Good. Does changing the flight affect my wife being listed on the hotel room or the work billing?

No. The hotel reservation is unchanged: Avery Thompson remains the primary guest and billing contact, your wife remains the second occupant, and the confirmed hotel total stays $1,087. Only the return flight was updated.
